description: Dated price comparison of two listed tools, from the vendor-verified plans in the directory: each tool's lowest paid plan, what it is priced per (flat, per seat, per mailbox), how it is billed, and the monthly total for a team of team_size. Prices that are unverified, older than 90 days or changed on the vendor page are left out, and then no comparison is returned. Tools priced per different units or billed differently are stated but not compared. Numbers and sums are computed in code, with the as-of date and the compare page URL to cite.

team_size.description: Seats for a per-seat plan. Default 5.

name: compare_pricing
title: Compare the prices of two GTM tools
